summary: San Francisco Bay Area resident, software developer with a focus on programming languages like Java and Python, strong interest in political and economic theories, particularly Austrian economics, avid reader of historical and political literature, engaged in discussions about digital nomadism and remote work, critical of mainstream media and political narratives, passionate about technology and its societal impacts, enjoys electronic music and follows niche music labels like Ektoplazm, has a personal mediawiki for organizing information, married with a wife met in Argentina, expresses skepticism towards government and corporate influence in personal and economic matters.
